```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  constructor
  · have : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := dvd_mul_right 2 (dvd_mul_right 2 (dvd_mul_right 2 (dvd_refl _)))
    exact this
  · have : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := dvd_mul_right 3 (dvd_mul_right 3 (dvd_mul_right 3 (dvd_refl _)))
    exact this
```
